Filter out orders where the parent order_status is 'canceled' or 'unavailable' to apply the revenue/sales scope.
Group by the English product category name and count the number of rows (items) in each group.
Sort the results by item count in descending order and return the top category and its count.

data.text: Good, I have the schema. Now I'll run the SQL query to join order_items with products and category_translation, filter out canceled/unavailable orders, group by English category name, count items, and get the top category.

args.purpose: Count items sold per product category (English), excluding canceled and unavailable orders
args.sql:
SELECT 
    ct.product_category_name_english,
    COUNT(*) AS item_count
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON p.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.order_id = oi.order_id 
    AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
)
GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY item_count DESC
LIMIT 10
